title: Five Strategies for Effectively Marketing to the Multi-Platform... - Comscore, Inc.

facts.fact: The Comscore blog post 'Five Strategies for Effectively Marketing to the Multi-Platform Majority' is dated 24 October 2013.
The post presents five key strategies for marketing to multi-platform audiences.
facts.quote: Here are five key strategies that can get you started on the right path.

facts.fact: Comscore states that reaching 18-34 year olds can be challenging via TV, but that this group is extremely heavy online video and smartphone users; no figures are given.
facts.quote: Reaching 18-34 year olds, for example, can be challenging via TV, but they are extremely heavy online video and smartphone users.

facts.fact: Comscore asserts that as platform proliferation grows, visitor metrics get inflated while conversion and average engagement metrics decline; the page gives no numeric measurements.
facts.quote: Visitor metrics get inflated while conversion and average engagement metrics decline.
